description: Display response rate for a marketplace over a period, grouped by page_type (the ad-unit surface the request served on). Returns raw ad requests, non-zero responses, and response rate (%) from the Display ad-unit fact table. Display branch of check_response_rate_by_page. No spend / no currency conversion.

page_type.description: The Display ad-unit surface the request served on (SEARCH, CATEGORY, PRODUCT, HOME, ...).

requests.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN r.requests ELSE 0 END), 0)
requests.description: Ad requests received on this page type.

responses.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN r.non_zero_responses ELSE 0 END), 0)
responses.description: Requests that returned at least one ad (non-zero responses) on this page type.

response_rate.selector: SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN r.non_zero_responses ELSE 0 END) * 100, NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN r.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN r.requests ELSE 0 END), 0))
response_rate.description: Response rate (%) = non-zero responses / requests * 100 on this page type.

query.REPORTING: SELECT __ATTRIBUTES__, __METRICS__ FROM `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.os_display_ads_ad_unit_facts` AS r JOIN `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.marketplace_clients` AS mc ON r.marketplace_client_id = mc.marketplace_client_id WHERE mc.agency_id = '__AGENCY_ID__' AND r.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' AND r.page_type IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(r.page_type) NOT IN ('', 'NA') AND __FILTER__ GROUP BY __ATTRIBUTES_GROUP_BY__;
